008package paint.viewer.model;
009
010import paint.shared.objects.Recording;
011import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
012
013import javax.swing.*;
014import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
015import java.nio.file.Path;
016
017/**
018 * Viewer-level wrapper for a {@link Recording} containing all metadata and
019 * preloaded image resources for a single experiment recording.
020 *
021 * <p>This entry supplies:</p>
022 * <ul>
023 *   <li>TrackMate overlay image (left display)</li>
024 *   <li>Brightfield image (right display)</li>
025 *   <li>Delegated metadata access (probe, adjuvant, concentration, density, etc.)</li>
026 *   <li>Access to the full {@link Recording} for retrieving squares</li>
027 * </ul>
028 *
029 * <p>The entry is immutable after construction. All square-level access and
030 * data manipulation occur on the underlying {@link Recording} instance.</p>
031 */
032public class RecordingEntry {
033
034    private final Recording recording;
035    private final String    experimentName;
036
037    private final ImageIcon leftImage;   // TrackMate overlay
038    private final ImageIcon rightImage;  // Brightfield
039
040    /**
041     * Creates a new immutable entry representing one recording inside an experiment.
042     *
043     * @param recording            the underlying domain object containing metadata and square data
044     * @param trackmateImagePath   file path to the TrackMate image (left panel)
045     * @param brightfieldImagePath file path to the Brightfield image (right panel)
046     * @param experimentName       parent experiment name
047     */
048    public RecordingEntry(Recording recording,
049            Path      trackmateImagePath,
050            Path      brightfieldImagePath,
051            String    experimentName) {
052
053        this.recording      = recording;
054        this.experimentName = experimentName;
055
056        this.leftImage  = loadImage(trackmateImagePath,   "TrackMate");
057        this.rightImage = loadImage(brightfieldImagePath, "Brightfield");
058    }
059
060    // =========================================================================================
061    // IMAGE LOADING
062    // =========================================================================================
063
064    /**
065     * Attempts to load an image using {@code ImageIO}, falling back to ImageJ’s
066     * {@code Opener} for formats ImageIO cannot handle (common for scientific data).
067     *
068     * @param imagePath the file path to load
069     * @param label     descriptive label for logging
070     * @return a Swing-compatible {@link ImageIcon}, or {@code null} on failure
071     */
072    private static ImageIcon loadImage(Path imagePath, String label) {
073        if (imagePath == null) {
074            return null;
075        }
076
077        // Attempt ImageIO first
078        try {
079            BufferedImage img = javax.imageio.ImageIO.read(imagePath.toFile());
080            if (img != null) {
081                PaintLogger.debugf("[%s] Loaded via ImageIO: %s", label, imagePath);
082                return new ImageIcon(img);
083            }
084            PaintLogger.warnf("[%s] ImageIO returned null: %s", label, imagePath);
085        } catch (Exception e) {
086            PaintLogger.warnf("[%s] ImageIO failed for %s (%s)", label, imagePath, e.getMessage());
087        }
088
089        // Fallback to ImageJ Opener
090        try {
091            ij.io.Opener opener = new ij.io.Opener();
092            ij.ImagePlus imp = opener.openImage(imagePath.toString());
093            if (imp != null && imp.getImage() != null) {
094                PaintLogger.debugf("[%s] Loaded via ImageJ Opener: %s", label, imagePath);
095                return new ImageIcon(imp.getImage());
096            }
097            PaintLogger.warnf("[%s] ImageJ Opener returned null for %s", label, imagePath);
098        } catch (Throwable t) {
099            PaintLogger.warnf("[%s] ImageJ Opener threw error for %s (%s)", label, imagePath, t.getMessage());
100        }
101
102        // Failure
103        PaintLogger.errorf("[%s] Failed to load image: %s", label, imagePath);
104        return null;
105    }
106
107    // =========================================================================================
108    // METADATA ACCESS
109    // =========================================================================================
110
111
112    /**
113     * @return the name of the recording.
114     */
115    public String getRecordingName() {
116        return recording.getRecordingName();
117    }
118
119    /**
120     * @return the name of the experiment.
121     */
122    public String getExperimentName() {
123        return experimentName;
124    }
125
126    /**
127     * @return the name of the probe.
128     */
129    public String getProbeName() {
130        return recording.getProbeName();
131    }
132
133    /**
134     * @return the type of probe.
135     */
136    public String getProbeType() {
137        return recording.getProbeType();
138    }
139
140    /**
141     * @return the adjuvant used.
142     */
143    public String getAdjuvant() {
144        return recording.getAdjuvant();
145    }
146
147    /**
148     * @return the cell type used.
149     */
150    public String getCellType() {
151        return recording.getCellType();
152    }
153
154    /**
155     * @return the probe concentration.
156     */
157    public double getConcentration() {
158        return recording.getConcentration();
159    }
160
161    /**
162     * @return the total number of spots.
163     */
164    public int getNumberOfSpots() {
165        return recording.getNumberOfSpots();
166    }
167
168    /**
169     * @return the total number of tracks.
170     */
171    public int getNumberOfTracks() {
172        return recording.getNumberOfTracks();
173    }
174
175    /**
176     * @return the analysis threshold.
177     */
178    public double getThreshold() {
179        return recording.getThreshold();
180    }
181
182
183    // =========================================================================================
184    // IMAGE AND RECORDING ACCESS
185    // =========================================================================================
186
187    /**
188     * @return the TrackMate preview image.
189     */
190    public ImageIcon getLeftImage() {
191        return leftImage;
192    }
193
194    /**
195     * @return the brightfield image.
196     */
197    public ImageIcon getRightImage() {
198        return rightImage;
199    }
200
201    /**
202     * @return the underlying {@link Recording} data object.
203     */
204    public Recording getRecording() {
205        return recording;
206    }
207}
